methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Virginia ranks fifth in workplace AI adoption, new report finds - WVIR
signals.signal_reading: Virginia ranking fifth nationally in workplace AI adoption suggests broad but likely platform-mediated usage across sectors, signaling shallow-but-distributed adoption rather than deep technical capability building at the organizational level.

signals.title: ‘Shaping our future’: Company powering AI data centers invests $50+ million in Henrico, adding 200 jobs - WWBT
signals.signal_reading: A $50M+ AI infrastructure investment adding 200 jobs in Henrico reinforces Richmond's emergence as a secondary hub, but the concentration of capital-intensive data center jobs risks creating capability islands rather than distributed AI fluency across the region.

signals.title: Mountain Empire Community College closing workforce center, relocating programs to campus
signals.signal_reading: Mountain Empire Community College closing its workforce center during the AI transition signals resource constraints in Appalachian Virginia precisely when distributed reskilling infrastructure is most needed, deepening the metro-rural divide.

signals.title: Virginia's best-paying jobs are most exposed to AI, report says - Axios
signals.signal_reading: High-wage jobs being most exposed to AI creates a bifurcated risk profile: metro professionals may adapt through deep reskilling while workers in regions without robust training ecosystems face displacement without capability-building pathways.

signals.title: To defend your software, first teach AI to break it - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech researchers developing AI security techniques demonstrates deep technical capability generation in New River Valley, creating potential knowledge spillover if academic-to-workforce pipelines can distribute these skills beyond the university ecosystem.
